mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the remainder with microbes was most worthwhile: the planned picture and prose connect undigested fibre to fatty acids and gas, while noting that microbes differ.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the fermenting contents to the body mostly placed an existing process in context; the later mucus combination brought the picture together more fully.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the model to show microbial fatty acids entering both colon lining cells and blood.

arbitrary.text: Adding mucus had a clear purpose in the completed cutaway, although its protective role is implied by separation rather than explicitly explained. It was also the only gameplay action offered at that point.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following a familiar meal into microbial fermentation and absorption made the biological connections interesting, though I'd want similarly clear explanations of new terms and structures.
